#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title and current date."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# 1. Verify input exists
if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
    print(f"ERROR: {INPUT} not found in {os.getcwd()}")
    print("Files present:", os.listdir("."))
    sys.exit(1)

# 2. Create the cover page PDF
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)

# Title centered vertically
c.setFont("Times-Bold", 36)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, TITLE)

# Date below the title
c.setFont("Times-Roman", 20)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, DATE_STR)

# A simple divider line
c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 - 60, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 - 60)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER}")

# 3. Prepend the cover page to report.pdf
reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as out_f:
    writer.write(out_f)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages "
      f"(1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} original)")
